I'm a data scientist working in **substance use epidemiology** at Johns Hopkins. I design studies and build the analytic and data-engineering infrastructure behind them: cross-sectional surveys, prospective cohorts, randomized and micro-randomized trials, intensive longitudinal data (EMA, wearables, smartphone GPS), and electronic health records.

Most of my time (about 75%) goes to statistical programming in **R** and **Python**: multilevel and mixed-effects models, GEE, structural equation and latent growth models, principled missing-data handling, simulation-based power analysis, and machine learning for time-series and sensor data. I care about reproducibility. My work uses version-controlled pipelines, documented codebooks, and open code on GitHub.

### Research interests

Cannabis, opioid, tobacco and alcohol use · Ecological momentary assessment · mHealth & just-in-time interventions · Chronic pain · Spatiotemporal methods · Reproducible health data science
